checks.title: Verify FileVault disk encryption status
checks.rationale: Full-disk encryption protects data at rest.
checks.remediation: Enable FileVault via System Settings > Privacy & Security.

checks.title: Verify Application Firewall is enabled
checks.rationale: The application firewall constrains inbound connections.
checks.remediation: Enable the firewall in System Settings > Network > Firewall.

checks.title: Review installed administrator accounts
checks.audit: Run 'dscl . -read /Groups/admin GroupMembership' and confirm each member is approved.
checks.rationale: Surplus admin accounts increase privilege exposure.
checks.remediation: Remove unapproved members from the admin group.
